Plan your visit · Aprés Gel-X

Scope the complete Gel-X set before crossing to 16th Street.

A 7th Street corridor guest should reserve Gel-X as a full-cover soft-gel extension service, including any old-product removal and the entire new set. Length, shape, repairs, finish, and art determine more than the base category alone. If the current nails are acrylic, dip, Builder Gel, or an unknown product, say so rather than assuming every system follows the same soak-off. The route is relatively direct within the Central Phoenix grid, but the service still needs enough time before the guest travels east to 6022 N 16th St.

Your appointment destination

What to know before visiting from 7th Street Corridor.

Appointments from 7th Street Corridor take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available.
